# AI-Ready Design Systems

> A curated, scored catalog of 237 production-grade design systems (web, iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native) for AI agents. Use it to pick the best design systems for a product idea, then build the product with the chosen system. Every entry passed a quality gate (actively maintained, real adoption) and is scored for AI-readiness (MCP server, llms.txt, machine-readable tokens, typed APIs, registry install).

Updated 2026-11-05. Machine-readable catalog: https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/catalog.json. Every system has a page at https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/<slug>.md (install, theming, AI resources, build guide); people can browse https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/index.html.

**Working from a clone instead of the web?** Every URL under https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/ maps to the `site/` folder of the repository (for example `site/catalog.json`, `site/systems/mui.md`). Each catalog entry also has a relative `path`.

## How to use this (instructions for agents)

When a user asks you to find design systems for a product idea:

1. **Understand the product.** Extract, or ask (at most 3 short questions, only if the answer changes the recommendation):
   - Platform(s): web, iOS, Android, cross-platform, desktop.
   - Stack: existing framework (from package.json, pubspec.yaml, *.xcodeproj, build.gradle, *.csproj), or none. **Build setup:** is there a bundler, or must it work as plain HTML from a CDN? Is Tailwind in use?
   - Product shape (`productShapes`: `app-dashboard`, `saas-app`, `marketing-site`, `content-site`, `forms-flows`, `mobile-app`, `chat-ai`, `ecommerce`) and audience/industry (`tags`).
   - Brand: the system's look as-is, light theming, or a fully custom brand (prefer headless or copy-the-source systems for full custom).
   - Constraints: accessibility level, density, dark mode, RTL, license, page weight.
2. **Filter** https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/catalog.json:
   - platform matches; framework matches (use `vanilla` for no-framework projects).
   - **Install fits the build setup:** no bundler → require `install.noBuild: true`; no Tailwind → exclude `install.requires` containing `tailwind`.
   - **Exclude `brandLocked`** systems unless the user works for that brand. Exclude `government`-tagged systems unless it is a public-sector service, and `*-ecosystem` tags unless building inside that ecosystem.
3. **Rank** what is left: fit with `productShapes` and `tags`/`bestFor` first, then stack/styling fit, then `tier` (recommended > solid > watch), `aiReadiness`, `popularity`. Use `attributes` (darkMode, rtl, packageSizeKB) to break ties when the user cares.
4. **One per family.** Systems with the same `family` are ports or variants of one system (for example Ant Design for React/Vue/Angular). Keep only the variant that matches the stack, so the top 3 are three genuinely different options.
5. **Read the page** (`page` URL) of your top 4–5 to confirm fit and caveats ("Consider an alternative if"). If `buildGuide.outdated` is true, plan to confirm setup in the system's own llms.txt or MCP server.
6. **Answer with the top 3**: for each, why it fits, the main trade-off, AI-readiness, install mode, and the page link. Say which one you recommend and why. Mention combinations where they apply (for example AI Elements or assistant-ui for chat on top of shadcn/ui; Tremor for charts).
7. **Build** once the user picks (or immediately if they asked you to build):
   - Follow the page's **Install** and **Setup** for the detected framework and version.
   - Connect its MCP server if listed, install any agent skills shipped in its package, and read its `llms.txt`. Prefer these over memory; APIs change between major versions.
   - Apply the brand once through the theme/tokens API, then follow the page's **Build checklist**.

## Scoring

- **Quality gate:** commit, release or package publish in the last 12 months (12–24 months = "watch"); not archived or deprecated; and at least one of ≥1.0k GitHub stars, ≥5.0k weekly npm downloads, ≥300 pub.dev likes, ≥1.0M NuGet downloads, or a known company/government/institution maintainer.
- **AI-readiness (0–100):** Official MCP server (agent can query components/docs live) (20); llms.txt on the docs site (15); llms-full.txt (whole docs as one markdown file) (5); Machine-readable design tokens in the repo (15); Typed component API (TypeScript / Swift / Kotlin / Dart / C#) (10); Registry / CLI install of component source (e.g. shadcn registry) (10); Agent docs: skills shipped in the package, or AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / cursor rules in the repo (5); Storybook / live, inspectable examples (5); Figma Code Connect (design ↔ code mapping) (5); Accessibility guidance shipped with the source (5); Dedicated documentation site (5).
- **Tiers:** recommended = passes the gate and AI-readiness ≥ 45 (platform-native systems always qualify); solid = passes the gate; watch = maintenance slowing.

## Web: React

- [HeroUI (formerly NextUI)](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/heroui.md): recommended, AI 95/100, react. Good-looking consumer and SaaS React apps on Tailwind with animations built in.
- [shadcn/ui](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/shadcn-ui.md): recommended, AI 80/100, react. Modern SaaS and AI apps on React/Next.js + Tailwind where you want to own and restyle component source.
- [Mantine](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/mantine.md): recommended, AI 85/100, react. Full-featured React apps needing 100+ components plus hooks, forms, dates, charts and notifications out of the box.
- [assistant-ui](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/assistant-ui.md): recommended, AI 90/100, react. Production AI chat UIs in React with streaming, attachments and tool UIs.
- [Chakra UI](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/chakra-ui.md): recommended, AI 85/100, react. Accessible, themeable React apps with style props; fast to brand.
- [Ark UI](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/ark-ui.md): recommended, AI 80/100, react, vue, solid, svelte. Headless, state-machine-based components across React, Vue, Solid and Svelte.
- [Material UI (MUI)](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/mui.md): recommended, AI 60/100, react. Feature-rich React apps and admin tools that benefit from Material Design and a huge component set (incl. MUI X data grid).
- [React Suite](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/rsuite.md): recommended, AI 80/100, react. React admin and enterprise apps with rich pickers, tables and form controls.

- [Ignite UI for Web Components](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/igniteui-webcomponents.md): recommended, AI 60/100, web-components. Data-heavy enterprise apps needing grids and inputs as web components.
- [NVIDIA Elements](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/nvidia-elements.md): recommended, AI 60/100, web-components. AI-factory and developer-tool UIs as web components with agent tooling.
- [Swiss Post Design System](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/swisspost.md): recommended, AI 45/100, web-components, angular, BRAND-LOCKED. Swiss Post digital products.
- [Flowbite](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/flowbite.md): solid, AI 40/100, any, react, vue, svelte, angular. Tailwind components with vanilla JS for any stack; good for marketing pages and admin templates.
- [Preline UI](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/preline.md): solid, AI 25/100, any. Tailwind components and plugins for marketing sites and dashboards in any stack.
- [HyperUI](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/hyperui.md): solid, AI 15/100, any. Free copy-paste Tailwind marketing and application sections.

- [Microsoft FAST](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/fast.md): solid, AI 35/100, web-components. Building your own web-component design system (Microsoft's foundation for Fluent web components).

- [HeroUI Native](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/heroui-native.md): recommended, AI 50/100, react-native. HeroUI's look for React Native apps on Tailwind (Uniwind/NativeWind).

- [React Native Reusables](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/rn-reusables.md): solid, AI 30/100, react-native. shadcn/ui-style copy-paste components for React Native with NativeWind.
- [React Native Elements](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/rn-elements.md): solid, AI 15/100, react-native. Cross-platform React Native UI toolkit with simple theming.
- [AWS Amplify UI](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/amplify-ui.md): solid, AI 35/100, react, vue, angular, react-native, flutter, swift. Auth, storage and AI UI connected to AWS Amplify across web and mobile.

## Flutter

- [Forui](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/forui.md): solid, AI 35/100, flutter. Minimalistic, shadcn-inspired Flutter widgets for desktop and mobile.
- [Fluent UI for Flutter](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/fluent-ui-flutter.md): solid, AI 20/100, flutter. Windows 11 Fluent look for Flutter desktop apps.
- [GetWidget](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/getwidget.md): solid, AI 15/100, flutter. Ready-made Flutter widgets for quick mobile MVPs.
- [macos_ui](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/macos-ui.md): solid, AI 15/100, flutter. macOS-native look for Flutter desktop apps.
- [AWS Amplify UI](https://kindavishal.github.io/ai-ready-design-systems/systems/amplify-ui.md): solid, AI 35/100, react, vue, angular, react-native, flutter, swift. Auth, storage and AI UI connected to AWS Amplify across web and mobile.

## Reference only (closed source: inspiration, not installable)

- Stripe Apps UI Toolkit (Stripe): https://docs.stripe.com/stripe-apps/components. Only usable inside Stripe Apps.
- Linear (Linear): https://linear.app. Closed source: use for inspiration only.
- Vercel Geist (Vercel): https://vercel.com/geist/introduction. Docs and fonts public; component code not published.
- ServiceNow Horizon (ServiceNow): https://horizon.servicenow.com. Closed source: use for inspiration only.
- BBC GEL (BBC): https://www.bbc.co.uk/gel. Closed source: use for inspiration only.
- Tailwind Plus (Tailwind UI / Catalyst) (Tailwind Labs): https://tailwindcss.com/plus. Paid license; agents can only use it if you own a license and provide the source.
- Wise Design (Wise): https://wise.design. Closed source: use for inspiration only.
- Airbnb Design Language (Airbnb): https://airbnb.design. Closed source: use for inspiration only.
- Mailchimp Design System (Intuit Mailchimp): https://ux.mailchimp.com/patterns. Closed source: use for inspiration only.
- HubSpot Canvas (HubSpot): https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/platform/ui-extensions. Closed source: use for inspiration only.
- Duolingo Design (Duolingo): https://design.duolingo.com. Closed source: use for inspiration only.
